parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerBehaviorTests.swift`. Although the Jaccard similarity is 0.7, the two methods belong to distinct test classes (`AudioPlayerCoreStateTests` and `AudioPlayerIdempotencyTests`) and verify different behavioural properties — core state after stop vs. idempotent play-after-stop — so the structural overlap is expected and intentional. Collapsing them would obscure the distinct test intent and violate the principle that each test should document one specific behaviour.
